breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the linear elastic bending theory (σ = My/I) rather than treating stress as uniform over the section depth. It explicitly states 'linear elastic bending theory (σ = My/I)', which means the stress at the neutral axis (y = 0) will correctly be zero, and the stress distribution will be linear — matching the ground truth and correcting the flawed instruction about uniform stress distribution.
